recs.stt: What I wish I knew when learning F#
recs.x:
You can use Babashka [link] for a quick and dirty setup to get you up and running quickly. That is also useful for scripting some things. You might also try shadow-cljs + ClojureScript, if you are more at home in the Node.js/ Browser JavaScript ecosystem and want to do something with it. There is a new "(Not)Babashka" but built on ClojureScript: [link] that might be interesting as well.

I have found this video by James Trunk: [link] to have a very nice live coding example.

cites.stt: Griffin – A fully-regulated, API-driven bank, with Clojure
cites.x: James Trunk, who is now Griffin's VP of Engineering, gave one of the most clear and enjoyable technical introductions to Clojure I've seen. Recommended! [link]
